COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JULY 23, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 6:30 PM

Samantha Mehlinger, Chair  Helena Donato-Sapp, Commissioner
Irma Archuleta, Vice Chair  Maria Gonzalez, Commissioner
Jennifer Allen Harper, Commissioner  Alyce LaViolette, Commissioner
Dr. Stephanie Anckle, Commissioner  Vanessa Mosqueda, Commissioner
Sophea Chim, Commissioner

  COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS IN-PERSON MEETING

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO ALANAH.GRANT@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 967 6296 8842
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/96762968842

  PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55873  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Commission for Women and Girls
  meeting of Wednesday, June 25, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55874  Recommendation to discuss and approve the transmittal of a letter to the Long
  Beach Human Trafficking Taskforce requesting their partnership in developing a
  report on the status of human trafficking in Long Beach.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55875  Recommendation to discuss and approve the transmittal of a letter to the Mayor
  and City Council in recognition of Women’s Equality Day and in support of local
  actions to advance gender equity in Long Beach.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JULY 23, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 6:30 PM

4.  25-55876  Recommendation to discuss and approve the Commission on Women and Girls’
  participation in upcoming community events: the Uptown Jazz Festival on
  Saturday, August 2, at Houghton Park, and the 3rd Annual Long Beach Women’s
  Fair on Tuesday, August 26, at Recreation Park.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55879  Recommendation to discuss and approve the resolution establishing the
  Commission for Women and Girls bylaws.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-55878  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

TREASURER ELECTION

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Commission for Women and Girls on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact he Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.

TREASURER ELECTION

A motion was made by Commissioner Allen Harper, to elect Commissioner Gonzalez for
Treasurer of the Commission for Women and Girls. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  8  Allen Harper, Anckle, Chim, Donato-Sapp, Gonzalez, LaViolette, Mosqueda,
  Mehlinger
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  0  None

Chair Mehlinger declared the nominations open for Treasurer.

Commissioner Allen Harper nominated Commissioner Gonzalez as Treasurer of the Commission for
Women and Girls.

There being no further nominations, Chair Mehlinger declared the nominations closed for Treasurer.

 Commissioner Gonzalez accepted the Treasurer of the Commission for Women and Girls
nomination.
